customManagers.description: The Wolfi base pinned by digest in the Dockerfile's ARG WOLFI_IMAGE; the tag floats on latest, so updates are digest refreshes
Fluent Bit source version, marked by a renovate comment above its ARG in the Dockerfile. FLUENT_BIT_SHA256 is not updated by Renovate: set it to the sha256 of the new codeload tarball in the same PR

packageRules.description: The Dockerfile manager must not also pin the Wolfi base: the custom manager above already does
Auto-merge Wolfi base digest refreshes once CI is green (CI verifies the new digest's Chainguard signature before building on it); apk upgrade still refreshes packages on the weekly rebuild
Fluent Bit bumps stay reviewed PRs: the Dockerfile's FLUENT_BIT_SHA256 needs a manual update
Keep the floating @v1 ref to our reusable workflows
